wikipediaRead.title: エン・ゲディ
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事は現代の町を説明し、2 Chronicles 20:2のハザゾン・タマルに当たるとする説を紹介します。古代の地点範囲まで同一と断定しません。

primaryWitnesses.text: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek the LORD. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
